crossRefs.note: “Remember, now, whoever perished, being innocent? Or where were the upright cut off?
“Shouldn’t the multitude of words be answered? Should a man full of talk be justified?
He who denounces his friends for plunder, Even the eyes of his children will fail.
Please don’t let me respect any man’s person, neither will I give flattering titles to any man.
For I don’t know how to give flattering titles, or else my Maker would soon take me away.
For truly my words are not false. One who is perfect in knowledge is with you.
They will put you out of the synagogues. Yes, the time comes that whoever kills you will think that he offers service…
But if our unrighteousness commends the righteousness of God, what will we say? Is God unrighteous who inflicts wrath?…
But we have renounced the hidden things of shame, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of God deceitfully…

translations.web: Will you speak unrighteously for God, and talk deceitfully for him?
translations.bsb: Will you speak wickedly on God’s behalf or speak deceitfully for Him?
translations.kjv: Will ye speak wickedly for God? and talk deceitfully
translations.asv: Will ye speak unrighteously for God, And talk deceitfully for him?
